# Windows
> Microsoft Windows is the operating system platform for Windows 11 PCs, apps, security, gaming, productivity, and device experiences.

Windows on Microsoft.com provides product overviews, feature guides, upgrade information, device selection help, and key resources for Windows 11 experiences across PCs, apps, accessibility, security, and connected devices.

## Windows Overview
- [Windows Home](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows): Main Windows hub for product information, features, devices, and upgrade paths.
- [Meet Windows 11](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/windows-11): Overview of Windows 11 features, design, and everyday productivity experiences.
- [How to get Windows 11](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/get-windows-11): Upgrade, purchase, and eligibility information for getting Windows 11.
- [Windows 11 specs & requirements](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/windows-11-specifications): Hardware requirements, specifications, and compatibility details for Windows 11.
- [Help me choose a PC](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/help-me-choose): Guided tool for selecting a Windows PC based on needs.

## Compare and Editions
- [Compare Windows 10 & 11](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/compare-windows-11-home-vs-pro-versions): Compare Windows versions, features, and edition differences.
- [Buy Windows 11 Home](https://www.microsoft.com/d/windows-11-home/dg7gmgf0krt0): Purchase page for the Windows 11 Home edition.
- [Buy Windows 11 Pro](https://www.microsoft.com/d/windows-11-pro/dg7gmgf0d8h4): Purchase page for the Windows 11 Pro edition.
- [How to get Windows 11 FAQ](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/get-windows-11#faq): Frequently asked questions about upgrading, eligibility, and installation.

## Security and Backup
- [Windows 11 security](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/comprehensive-security): Overview of built-in Windows 11 security protections and safeguards.
- [Windows Backup](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/transfer-your-data-with-windows-backup): Guide to backing up files, settings, and transferring data.
- [Windows 11 specs & requirements](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/windows-11-specifications): Requirements relevant to secure and supported Windows 11 installations.

## AI and Creativity
- [AI features in Windows](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/ai-features): Overview of AI-powered features available across Windows experiences.
- [Photo & movie editing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/photo-movie-editor): Tools and features for editing photos and creating videos on Windows.
- [Draw & create with Paint](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/paint): Paint app capabilities for drawing, image creation, and editing.
- [Digital pen, voice & touch](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/digital-pen-touch-voice-features): Input features for pen, voice, and touch-based creation and control.

## Apps and Productivity
- [Apps for Windows](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/apps-for-windows): Discover applications and software experiences available on Windows.
- [Sync smartphones to computer](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/sync-across-your-devices): Connect phones and PCs for cross-device access and continuity.
- [Meet Windows 11](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/windows-11): Productivity-focused overview of the Windows 11 desktop experience.

## Gaming
- [PC gaming on Windows 11](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/windows-11-pc-gaming): Windows 11 gaming features, performance, and PC gaming experiences.
- [Apps for Windows](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/apps-for-windows): Broader software ecosystem that supports gaming and entertainment use cases.
- [Help me choose a PC](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/help-me-choose): Find a Windows PC suited for gaming and performance needs.

## Accessibility and Input
- [Windows accessibility features](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/accessibility-features): Accessibility tools and inclusive features built into Windows.
- [Digital pen, voice & touch](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/digital-pen-touch-voice-features): Input and interaction options for different workflows and accessibility needs.
- [Sync smartphones to computer](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/sync-across-your-devices): Device continuity features that support flexible access across screens.

## Buying and Upgrade Paths
- [How to get Windows 11](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/get-windows-11): Primary resource for upgrading, buying, or installing Windows 11.
- [Buy Windows 11 Home](https://www.microsoft.com/d/windows-11-home/dg7gmgf0krt0): Direct purchase option for Windows 11 Home.
- [Buy Windows 11 Pro](https://www.microsoft.com/d/windows-11-pro/dg7gmgf0d8h4): Direct purchase option for Windows 11 Pro.
- [Help me choose a PC](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/help-me-choose): Shop guidance for choosing a compatible Windows device.
- [Compare Windows 10 & 11](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/compare-windows-11-home-vs-pro-versions): Compare editions and decide which Windows version fits your needs.
